references.title: DWDS: Messer
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for das Messer, the knife; Herkunft an obscured compound, ahd. meʒʒisahs (9th c.), not from messen

notes.rationale: The knife, das Messer. DWDS gives this homograph no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word with no Constituents: the Root messer and the zero ending (ADR 0051). der Messer, who or what measures, splits messen + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
